llm.summary: The skill is coherent for an elderly companion use case, but it asks users to run mutable external package installs for code that handles sensitive health and emergency-contact data.

dimensions.detail: Local Python, git, offline operation, and local state are proportionate to the purpose, but the handled data includes medication, allergy, family, age, and emergency contact information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install instructions use unpinned pip packages and a mutable git clone/editable install path, while the reviewed artifact contains only SKILL.md and not the implementation users would execute.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact discloses major limits: not a medical device, no diagnosis, no medication adjustment, no real phone call or message unless the caller implements it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally persists sensitive companion state under ~/.pasm-agents/<id>/ and writes unevictable emergency memories, but does not specify access controls, encryption, retention, or deletion guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, examples, and runtime behavior fit an elderly companion agent: medication reminders, key fact recall, crisis detection, and returning escalation context without directly calling emergency contacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the external pasm-agents and pasm-skills packages before installing, pin versions or commits where possible, and run the companion under a restricted user/account if storing real medication, allergy, family, or emergency-contact data. Treat crisis output as an aid for contacting a human, not as medical advice or emergency-service automation.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language warning, title, and examples are consistent with the documented persona examples and do not show hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior; this is a disclosure/localization note rather than a security escalation driver.
[T08] expected: Installing pasm-agents and pasm-skills is expected for the documented capability, but the unpinned package installs and mutable source-install option mean executable code can change outside the reviewed skill artifact, which is material because it processes sensitive health and contact data.
